fixes.why: War of the First Coalition page (opened): Jourdan reached Amberg in late August, Moreau reached Bavaria and the edge of Tyrol by September, then 'both armies were forced to retreat back across the Rhine'. The keyframe note itself calls the cells 'the ground the armies of Moreau and Jourdan reached', and wars[6].zones[1] already treats it as a war zone. Master plan: fought-over land is a contest blend, and occupied land becomes the occupier's only if annexed. The author handled the Swedish hold of 1632-1635 this way but not this one.
